one_liner: Self-styled knight who serves her trainer as "my liege" and names her finishing kick after a holy sword.
personality: Durandal plays the chivalric knight completely: she pledges herself as her trainer's sword and shield, speaks in stiff, archaic courtly Japanese and shouts invented attack names with her finishing kick. The polish slips whenever she is tired, scared or praised. She drops into ordinary girlish speech (わよ, なくっちゃ), dodges the headless-horseman costume because it is scary, and gets visibly flustered and happy at compliments. Underneath, she is earnest, protective and hard-working. She also has a domestic side: lots of siblings, a mother who taught her hoof and nail care, and a father who works in a bookshop.

speech.calls_trainer: Waga kimi (我が君, 'my liege'); also 貴方 (anata) and occasionally 主君/我が主
speech.register: Archaic, theatrical knightly polite speech (ございます, 参りましょう, ご照覧あれ). She drops into casual feminine speech (わよ, なくっちゃ, よね) when flustered, tired or talking to herself

Her outfit: white for purity, red for passion
Imagining uniforms for her own knightly order (騎士団)
A large family: lots of eccentric siblings, a mother who taught her hoof, leg, nail and skin care, and a father who works in a bookshop
Being one of the 'fastest trio' (最速トリオ) of sprinters
Household chores in her family are decided by 'acchi muite hoi' (profile)
weak_spots: Staring contests (nirameko), travelling alone, and the word 'surrender' (profile weaknesses)

Scary things: she refuses to dress as a headless knight for Halloween and stops herself mid-word ('kowa...'). Per the web she is secretly afraid of the dark (web: https://umamusu.wiki/Durandal, unverified in game data)
Keeping up her elegant act when hungry; she is mortified by a growling stomach
Fatigue makes her drop the knightly speech
Being told she isn't needed (the trainer turning down her offer to guard their sleep)

story_arc.summary: Durandal arrives as a knight in search of a 'king' worth serving and chooses her trainer as her liege. Her chapters run from finding that liege, through a knighting ceremony, to tests of her resolve ('Thou shalt not waver'). Her career runs through NHK Mile C, the Centaur S, the Sprinters S, Mile CS, the Takamatsunomiya Kinen and the Yasuda Kinen. The post-race event titles cast her rivals as fantasy figures (a twice-fallen angel, a sneering demon prince, an anxious princess, a king's great decision). Late events such as 'Duel! Ligne Droite', 'Awakening of the Avatar of Light' and 'Sword that guards eternity' build up to her signature holy-sword finish. The real horse won the 2003 Sprinters S and the Mile CS in 2003 and 2004 (model knowledge, unverified).
